messages:
support_jane: Customer reported intermittent streaming failures during hosted inference. Gateway logs show 502 and customer sees TLS connection reset mid-stream. They're disputing charges because these were billed as 5xx.

alex: Can you share the gateway request_id and a snippet of the client logs? Suspect proxy half-close vs client RST.

support_jane: request_id=req_7a8b9c. Sample gateway log:
```
[2026-03-15T15:04:12Z] req_7a8b9c upstream read error: connection reset by peer; status=502 duration=0.002s
```
Client reported: "stream ended with ECONNRESET after ~8s of tokens".

devops_tom: Is the client using HTTP chunked streaming or websockets? If chunked, some proxies turn abrupt upstream close into 502.

maria: Customer says they're using chunked transfer encoding to consume token stream from /v1/streams. Host=api.redwood.com. This looks like upstream (our inference worker) closed without sending final chunk trailer.

alex: Can you paste the curl they used? Also check whether the worker logged any OOM or GPU preemption.

support_jane: cURL they used:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://api.redwood.com/v1/streams -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","prompt":"..."}'
```
No OOMs in worker logs for that request id.

eng_bot: [alert] streaming.client-reset-rate spiked +28% at 2026-03-15T15:04:00Z for region=us-west.

billing_oliver: The customer was billed for tokens after we marked request as 5xx. They want the charges re-evaluated if this was a client-side reset.

devops_tom: Repro suggestion: run a client that issues a TCP RST mid-stream vs a graceful close. Quick test with `nc`:
```
# open TCP connection and then kill it to simulate RST
printf 'POST /v1/streams HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: api.redwood.com\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nAuthorization: Bearer ...\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n' | nc api.redwood.com 443
# then kill -9 the nc process
```
This reproduces abrupt socket teardown at the client.

maria: I'll run a packet capture on staging and add traces on the gateway to see who sent FIN/RST. If it's client RST, we should not count as 5xx for billing.

alex: Short-term mitigation: update metrics rule to exclude cases with upstream_response_bytes==0 and connection_close==client_reset from 5xx billing classification. Need eng-sre sign-off.

support_jane: I'll document repro steps and ask for a billing note. Assigning to @maria and @devops_tom to confirm root cause. :eyes:

maria: Got it, starting traces now. Will post a reproducible script and timeline.

support_jane: Thanks all — will update customer once we have a repro and billing decision. :thumbsup:
